correctness.rationale: The proof characterizes disconnected complements in \(C_{k+6}^2\) by having at least two deleted cyclic runs of length at least two. Positive-composition counting gives the facet formula; a complete characterization of nonextendable five-sets gives \(f_4\); an explicit extension argument gives the complete four-skeleton; algebra then gives the Euler characteristic. The standalone verifier reconstructs every complex for \(3\le k\le14\) directly from graph connectivity and matches every formula, but this finite check is not used as the proof for arbitrary \(k\).

value.rationale: The parameter line \(n=k+6\) is the first diagonal of the published squared-cycle shellability conjecture. The result gives its exact all-parameter enumerative data and fixes the only possible number of five-spheres if shellability holds, separating a concrete combinatorial component of the open problem from the remaining topological question. This is structurally different from the adjacent \(n=k+5\) theorem rather than a mere finite increment.
